item.title: Sen. Paul: "Very real chance" Fauci could be prosecuted after Senate hearing
item.description: Hours after Dr. Anthony Fauci invoked the Fifth Amendment in response to all questions during a Senate hearing, Republican Sen. Rand Paul of Kentucky told CBS News he believes Fauci could be prosecuted.

item.title: Rep. Debbie Dingell urges Michigan Democrats to unite regardless of who wins Senate primary
item.description: The closely-watched Democratic Senate primary in Michigan between Abdul El-Sayed and Haley Stevens is less than one week away. Democratic Rep. Debbie Dingell of Michigan joins "The Takeout" to weigh in on the divisions in the race.

item.title: OpenAI interested in ChatGPT wearable integrations
item.description: OpenAI's president says it is working on wearable and hardware options for its AI chatbots like ChatGPT. CNET editor-at-large Scott Stein joins CBS News to discuss this and other technology headlines.

item.title: Trump warns Iran is set to "get a beating" as 5-month war expands
item.description: The war in the Middle East is expanding, with President Trump threatening Iran with "a beating" and the U.S. and Saudi Arabia jointly striking Iranian proxies in Iraq.

item.title: New DOJ rule would allow immigration judges to hold lawyers in contempt
item.description: The Justice Department is proposing a new rule to empower federal immigration judges to hold attorneys, their clients and witnesses in contempt if they violate court orders.

item.title: Why are workers at leading AI companies calling for a slowdown in AI development?
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and other AI leaders say they support pacing the rapid advancement of AI's capabilities.

item.title: 911 call from Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband plays in court
item.description: Wednesday marked the second day of the high-profile trial against Lindsay Clancy. She's charged with three counts of first-degree murder and facing life in prison for the killings of her three children in 2023. CBS News correspondent Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Salman Rushdie recounts getting stabbed (2024)
item.description: Jurors on Wednesday convicted a man of federal terrorism charges for the 2022 stabbing of author Salman Rushdie. In 2024, Rushdie spoke with Anderson Cooper about the attack.

item.title: Sen. Rand Paul, Dr. Deborah Birx and Dr. Céline Gounder discuss Fauci's COVID-19 Senate hearing
item.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci invoked the Fifth Amendment over a hundred times at a Senate hearing Wednesday on the COVID-19 pandemic, citing GOP Sen. Rand Paul's "unhinged obsession" with him. Paul, former White House Coronavirus Response Coordinator Dr. Deborah Birx and CBS News medical correspondent Dr. Céline Gounder join "The Takeout" to unpack the hearing.

item.title: Fact-checking Sen. Rand Paul's claim about COVID-19 testing in animals around Wuhan
item.description: CBS News medical correspondent Dr. Céline Gounder joins "The Takeout" to discuss claims made by Sen. Rand Paul about the COVID-19 pandemic and the contentious hearing on Capitol Hill Wednesday with Dr. Anthony Fauci.

item.title: What records reveal about Newsom's taxpayer-funded, California-branded free diaper program
item.description: CBS California Investigates reviewed 356 pages of state records behind California's $6.2 million diaper contract with Baby2Baby. Here is what they show.

item.title: Dr. Deborah Birx on combative Fauci hearing: "We have to have a better way forward than this"
item.description: Former White House Coronavirus Response Coordinator Dr. Deborah Birx worked, in her words, in the trenches with Dr. Anthony Fauci during the COVID-19 pandemic. Birx joins "The Takeout" with her thoughts on Fauci's diaries, his actions during the pandemic and the debate over COVID's origins.

item.title: Salman Rushdie attacker convicted in federal trial over 2022 stabbing
item.description: A man has been convicted of federal terrorism charges in the 2022 stabbing of author Salman Rushdie.

item.title: Fed holds interest rates steady, but 3 officials vote for hike
item.description: Fed officials are leaving their benchmark rate unchanged for a fifth straight meeting, a sign they expect inflation to ease.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy trial jury hears ex-husband's 911 call after murders
item.description: Lindsay Clancy is standing trial on charges that she murdered her three young children in Duxbury, Massachusetts, in 2023.

item.title: Sen. Rand Paul says there's a "very real chance" Fauci could be prosecuted after contentious hearing
item.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci repeatedly invoked the Fifth Amendment during a Senate hearing about the COVID-19 pandemic on Wednesday, angering Republican lawmakers. GOP Sen. Rand Paul of Kentucky, who led the hearing, joins "The Takeout" with his reaction.

item.title: Elephants that died in Kenya likely poisoned by cyanide-tainted tomatoes
item.description: Fifteen elephants in southern Kenya are suspected to have been poisoned by cyanide-contaminated tomatoes, according to wildlife authorities.

item.title: FTC sues Hims & Hers, alleging it shared health data with Meta, Snap
item.description: Telehealth platform disclosed users' "most private" health info and locked consumers into subscriptions, regulators allege.

item.title: Trump-affiliated companies distance themselves from Trump-IRS deal
item.description: Top Senate Democrats sought answers about Trump IRS deal from mining company Kaz Resources, cryptocurrency companies World Liberty Financial and prediction markets Polymarket and Kalshi.

item.title: Trump unveils plans for overhaul of Dulles airport outside Washington
item.description: President Trump said he hopes the renovations will take Dulles from "an impossible airport" to one of the world's best.

item.title: How Trump drafted renovation plans for Dulles, a "terrible airport"
item.description: President Trump asked for 3D models of the renovation proposals as he personally tweaked ideas to overhaul Dulles International Airport that are scheduled to be unveiled on Wednesday.

item.title: Singer-songwriter Glen Hansard killed in motorcycle crash
item.description: Academy Award-winning Irish singer-songwriter Glen Hansard has died in a motorcycle crash.

item.title: Friend describes last known movements of missing American in Grenada
item.description: American Elizabeth Waddell was last seen on July 22 while visiting the tiny Caribbean island of Grenada.

item.title: GOP targeted progressive dark money. That could boomerang on Trump.
item.description: The Trump-linked group Freedom 250 staged America's birthday with tens of millions that it is not required to disclose.

item.title: Cyclospora boosts fears that deadlier foodborne outbreaks are ahead
item.description: Food safety experts say cuts to the public health system hobbled the response — and that the next outbreak could be much worse.

item.title: North Carolina woman missing in Grenada as husband heads to join search
item.description: Elizabeth "Liz" Waddell was last seen at Grand Anse Beach on Wednesday, July 22, the Royal Grenada Police Force said on social media.

item.title: Maya and Dean Jankelowitz serve up comfort food to New Yorkers with Jack's Wife Freda
item.description: Dean and Maya Jankelowitz aim to serve up a tradition of food, family, and grandmotherly magic at Jack's Wife Freda, their New York City restaurant chain. Their signature comfort food keeps New Yorkers and tourists coming back for more.

item.title: The Dish: Recipe: Try pickle-brined chicken salad for a summer favorite
item.description: In the series "The Dish: Recipe," Janice Carte, of Tiny Spoon Chef, shows how to make the light summertime recipe, pickle-brined chicken salad.

item.title: California still hasn't released Baby2Baby diaper contract as lawmakers weigh longer public records delays
item.description: The Newsom administration waited 24 days to decide if it would even let Californians see the multi-million-dollar contract with Baby2Baby, a nonprofit linked to First Partner Jennifer Siebel Newsom.

item.title: Critics got California's free diaper math wrong, but state won't release key Baby2Baby records
item.description: A CBS News California fact-check found the state's free diaper program won't cost taxpayers 50 cents per diaper, as viral posts claimed. But the Newsom administration still won't release the Baby2Baby contract or competitive bid records amid concerns free diapers could go to waste.
